cloud.link_key_required: This link needs a decryption key
cloud.unsupported: Pawstash can't browse this type of archive yet. Download it and open it in an archive app.

creator.no_announcements_desc: There are no community posts or announcements from this creator yet.
creator.no_fancards_desc: This creator has no fancards yet.
creator.no_links_desc: This creator does not have other platform accounts linked yet.
creator.no_similar_artists_desc: There are no similar creator recommendations yet.
creator.not_found_on_provider_desc: {provider} has no posts from this creator. Merged checks every source.

creators.empty_desc: Try changing your search query or service filter.
creators.search_placeholder: Search creators by name or ID…

downloads.cancel_all_desc: Running, waiting and paused downloads stop. Files that already finished stay.
downloads.empty_desc: Files you download from posts appear here. Unfinished downloads resume after the app restarts.
downloads.group_by_posts_desc: Combine downloaded media from the same post.
downloads.open_in_system_desc: Open in an external player or app.
downloads.show_in_folder_desc: Reveal the file in the system file manager.
downloads.show_in_folder_failed: Couldn't show the file in the file manager

favorites.empty_creators_desc: Creators you favorite will appear here.
favorites.empty_creators_guest: No favorite creators yet. Favorites are saved on this device and sync through Pawstash Sync.
favorites.empty_posts_desc: Posts you favorite will appear here.
favorites.empty_posts_guest: No favorite posts yet. Favorites are saved on this device and sync through Pawstash Sync.

feed.empty_desc: This feed is empty. Try refreshing it in a moment.
feed.favorite_creators_desc: Show only posts from favorite creators.
feed.title: Feed
feed.with_attachments_desc: Show only posts with media files.

library.clear_confirm: Posts are removed from this stash but stay in your main library.
library.delete_confirm: The posts inside stay in your main library.
library.empty_desc: Save a post from the feed or choose another stash.
library.only_downloaded_desc: Show only posts saved to local disk.
library.title: Library

onboarding.community_desc: Ask questions and suggest features in Telegram or on Reddit.
onboarding.save_desc: Tap the bookmark on any post.
onboarding.sync_desc: An encrypted copy you can open on your other devices.
onboarding.sync_nudge_desc: Turn on sync to keep a copy if something happens to this device.
onboarding.sync_nudge_title: Your library is only on this device
onboarding.title: Get started

post.cloud_file_unavailable: File isn't available from the source
post.cloud_scraping_off: Link inspection is turned off in settings
post.codec_alt_player_desc: Or download the video file and open it in a media player with built-in codecs (VLC, MPC-HC, PotPlayer, or MPV).
post.codec_sideload_hint: Official signed Microsoft packages (OEM redistributables) that install without Microsoft Store.
post.codec_why_desc: To play H.265 (HEVC) videos, install the system codec.
post.codec_windows_note: After installing the codec, restart Pawstash to apply the changes.
post.decode_error: Playback decode error (unsupported codec or damaged stream)

delete_downloaded_desc.one: This deletes the {count} file you saved from this post.
delete_downloaded_desc.other: This deletes the {count} files you saved from this post.

post.error_forbidden_hint: The server blocked access, or a temporary rate limit applies. Try again later or use a proxy.
post.error_not_found_hint: The file was removed or isn't on the source server.
post.error_rate_limited_hint: Too many requests to the media server. Wait a moment before retrying.
post.error_server_hint: The source media server returned an error.
post.file_not_archived: File isn't archived on the source
post.file_not_saved_desc: This file exceeds the archive size limit and was not saved.
post.no_media_found_desc: No attachments match your search query.
post.not_found_on_provider_desc: {provider} doesn't have this post. Merged checks every source.
post.source_page: The source returned a web page instead of a video. The link may be private, expired, or need a browser.
post.unsupported_codec_desc: H.265 (HEVC) video requires a system codec to play.
post.unsupported_format_desc: The built-in player doesn't support the {format} container or codec.
post.unsupported_format_hint: Download the file or open it in an external player such as VLC or MPV.

settings.accent_color_desc: The color the whole palette is built from.
settings.android_open_by_default_desc: Let Android send supported creator and post links here.
settings.aria2c_engine_desc: Several connections per file, when aria2c is installed. Otherwise the built-in downloader is used.
settings.auth_logout_confirm_desc: What should happen to favorites added during this session?
settings.auth_sync_prompt_desc: Sync favorites between the app and your {provider} account?
settings.author: Author
settings.auto_check_updates_desc: Look for a new version each time the app starts.
settings.background_image_desc: Pawstash keeps its own copy, so the original can be moved.
settings.background_media_clear_confirm: Remove the custom wallpaper and go back to the default background?
settings.background_media_desc: Delete the copy and go back to the gradient.
settings.background_opacity_desc: How visible the custom background is.
settings.background_tint_desc: Lay a light wash of the accent color over the background.
settings.background_tint_opacity_desc: How strongly the accent shows through.
settings.background_video_desc: Plays muted on a loop. Pawstash keeps its own copy.
settings.bg_type_desc: Effects your system doesn't support are hidden.
settings.blur_previews_desc: Show a soft blurred image while the real one loads.
settings.cache_clear_all_confirm: Delete all cached images, feed snapshots, and temporary data from disk?
settings.cache_clear_all_desc: Also feed pages and saved post snapshots. Your library, favorites and downloads stay.
settings.cache_clear_desc: Previews, avatars and banners. They load again when needed.
settings.cache_limit_desc: Older images are removed once the cache grows past this.
settings.cache_usage_desc: Cached previews, avatars, and creator banners stored on this device.
settings.card_view_mode_desc: Minimal hides the file badges and like counts.
settings.cloud_max_redirects_desc: How many redirects a cloud link may follow.
settings.cloud_proxy_url_desc: Helps when Mega or Google Drive limit you by IP. Leave empty to use the main proxy.
settings.cloud_scraping_enabled_desc: Open Google Drive, Mega, Dropbox, Pixeldrain and similar links right in the post.
settings.cloud_timeout_desc: Seconds before opening a cloud link gives up.
settings.cloud_user_agent_desc: Leave empty to use the one for websites and files.
settings.color_mode_desc: Follow the system, or always use light or dark.
settings.color_scheme_desc: How colorful the palette built from the accent is.
settings.color_scheme_neutral_source: The accent is close to gray, so the palette stays muted.
settings.content_indexing_enabled: Look inside saved archives and folders
settings.content_indexing_enabled_desc: In the background, list the files in ZIP archives and cloud folders of posts in your library and favorites, so format filters find the videos and photos inside.
settings.copy_logs_desc: Paste them into a bug report.
settings.download_auto_retry_desc: Re-queue downloads that fail from a timeout, a dropped connection or a server error. Missing files and disk errors are not retried.
settings.download_auto_retry_max_desc: How many times a download is retried before it is marked as failed.
settings.download_creator_template_desc: Tags are replaced with the creator's details.
settings.download_filename_template_desc: Repeated names get a number, and the extension is always kept.
settings.download_group_by_creator_desc: Each creator gets their own folder.
settings.download_group_by_post_desc: Each post gets its own folder.
settings.download_max_concurrent_desc: How many files can download at the same time.
settings.download_metadata_format_desc: .txt to read, .json for the full data.
settings.download_post_template_desc: Tags are replaced with the post's details.
settings.download_preview_desc: Where a file would be saved with these settings.
settings.download_save_metadata_desc: A file with the post text, creator, date and link next to the media.
settings.downloads_storage_desc: Everything in your download history, by type.
settings.dynamic_accent_desc: On post and creator pages, take the accent from the cover image.
settings.font_family_desc: A font name, or several separated by commas. Leave empty for the system font.
settings.get_help_desc: Ask in the Telegram chat and attach the logs.
settings.grid_ratio_desc: Applies to every grid in the app.
settings.grid_scale_desc: Cards grow or shrink along with their text and icons.
settings.grid_scale_desc_keyboard: Ctrl + mouse wheel changes it on any grid.
settings.layout_mode_desc: Auto switches to the phone layout when the window is narrow.
settings.linux_transparent_window_desc: Lets the compositor show through behind the app. Costs scrolling performance under WebKitGTK and causes after-images with translucent custom backgrounds. Takes effect after a restart.
settings.network_api_user_agent_desc: How Pawstash introduces itself to archive sources.
settings.network_browser_user_agent_desc: Sent to file hosts and the downloader, which expect a browser. Images and video use it after a restart.
settings.network_connect_timeout_desc: Seconds to wait for a server to accept the connection.
settings.network_timeout_desc: Seconds to wait for an answer before giving up.
settings.notifications_enabled_desc: Tells you when a download finishes. On desktop, only while Pawstash is in the background.
settings.notifications_show_preview_desc: Add the image or video thumbnail.
settings.notifications_sound_desc: Play the system sound when a download finishes.
settings.panic_button_desc: Hotkey that instantly hides the window to the tray and mutes or pauses all audio and video.
settings.panic_button_shortcut_desc: Click the field and press the key combination you want.
settings.parallel_connections_desc: How many connections aria2c opens for one file.
settings.pawchive_hide_ai_desc: Exclude AI-generated content from the feed, creators, and search.
settings.provider_advanced_network_desc: Override the global network settings for this provider only. Turning it off keeps the values but stops applying them.
settings.provider_deadline_desc: Seconds to wait for the other sources once one has answered, on post and creator pages. Feeds never wait.
settings.provider_max_retries_desc: How many times a failed request is retried before giving up.
settings.provider_min_interval_desc: Milliseconds enforced between two requests to this provider.
settings.provider_missing: This source is no longer available.
settings.provider_proxy_url_desc: Route only this provider through a separate proxy. Leave empty to use the global proxy.
settings.provider_timeout_desc: Seconds before a request to this provider is abandoned.
settings.provider_user_agent_desc: Leave empty to use the global API User-Agent shown as the placeholder.
settings.proxy_bypass_local_desc: Connect directly to localhost and local network addresses.
settings.proxy_mode_desc: System follows the device proxy and the HTTP_PROXY variables.
settings.proxy_password_desc: Kept in the system's secure storage.
settings.reset_all_confirm: Reset all settings to their defaults? This also resets the theme and appearance.
settings.reset_all_desc: Reset all settings to default values.
settings.reset_section_confirm: Reset settings in this section to default values?
settings.search_hidden_desc: It appears on this page once the setting it depends on is turned on.
settings.session_cookie_help: The “session” cookie value from your browser.
settings.titlebar_style_desc: The style of the minimize, maximize and close buttons.
settings.ui_scale_desc: Scales text, controls and spacing together. Follows your system text size until you change it.
settings.ui_scale_desc_keyboard: Shortcuts: Ctrl+=, Ctrl+−, Ctrl+0, or Ctrl+wheel outside grids.
settings.update_channel_desc: Beta gets new features first, along with more bugs.
settings.webview_proxy_restart: Restart Pawstash so images, video and embeds follow these network settings too. Until then they load the way they did at startup.
settings.webview_proxy_unsupported: On this platform images, video and embeds are loaded by the system WebView, which can't be routed through the app's proxy. They follow the system proxy instead.
settings.wipe_all_data_confirm: Reset your library, stashes, subscriptions, and cache? This can't be undone.
settings.wipe_all_data_desc: Wipes all stashes, subscriptions, download history, and content cache.
settings.wipe_all_data_success: Library and data have been reset

subscriptions.active_desc: Check for and fetch new posts on a schedule.
subscriptions.auto_download_desc: Queue new posts for background download automatically.
subscriptions.batch_unsubscribe_remove_posts: Also remove posts by these creators from library stashes

clear_posts_confirm_desc.one: This removes {count} saved post by this creator from {stash}. Other items in this stash aren't affected.
clear_posts_confirm_desc.other: This removes all {count} saved posts by this creator from {stash}. Other items in this stash aren't affected.

subscriptions.clear_posts_desc: Remove all posts saved by this creator from the selected stash.
subscriptions.destination_desc: Stash where imported posts are saved.
subscriptions.download_scope_desc: Download only the primary attachment or all media files.
subscriptions.empty_desc: Open a creator and choose Subscribe.
subscriptions.initial_import_desc: How many existing posts to save when activating the subscription.
subscriptions.interval_desc: How often to check for new posts in the background.
subscriptions.save_to_library_desc: Automatically add new posts from this creator to your library.

sync.account_id_invalid_desc: Only English letters, digits, dashes, and underscores are allowed (8–128 characters).
sync.account_id_too_short_desc: Account ID must be at least 8 characters long.
sync.account_taken: This account ID is already taken. Generate or enter another one.
sync.auto_sync_desc: Check for changes from your other devices on a schedule.
sync.benefit_devices: Your library and stashes on any device
sync.benefit_private: Encrypted on this device before upload, so the server can't read it
sync.disconnect_confirm_desc: This device stops syncing and forgets the account. Your library stays on this device; sign in again with the account ID and master password.
sync.enable_sync_desc: Library, stashes and subscriptions. Encrypted before they leave the device.
sync.lock_desc: Remove the vault keys from this device. Unlocking asks for the master password.
sync.master_password_desc: Password that encrypts data on your device (at least 12 characters).
sync.password_hint_create: At least 12 characters. It can't be reset, so save the Recovery Kit on the next screen.
sync.persist_in_app_favorites_locally_desc: Copies creators and posts favorited in the app to local guest favorites so they stay after you sign out.
sync.push_interval_desc: Changes made in between are sent together.
sync.recovery_warning: Store this Recovery Kit somewhere safe. You need it to restore your library on other devices.
sync.sync_on_change_desc: Otherwise they're sent on a schedule.
sync.sync_pawchive_session_desc: Sign in on one device and the others are signed in too. The session is encrypted.
sync.test_connection_success_desc: Connected to the sync server (HTTP 200 OK).
sync.title: Library sync

update.up_to_date_desc: You're on the latest version of Pawstash.
